CustomField.label: Contact person left
CustomField.description: SCRUM-453 AC-7: Read-only indicator on the Case, derived from the Case's Contact lookup, so Service sees at once - without opening the Contact - that the contact person of this Case no longer works at the customer. Blank when the Case has no Contact or the Contact is still active.
CustomField.formula: IF(Contact.Has_Left_Company__c, "Austritt - not there any more (" & TEXT(Contact.Left_Company_Date__c) & ")", "")
